verses.original: שֹׁפָ֔ר אֶל־ חִכְּךָ֣ כַּנֶּ֖שֶׁר עַל־ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה יַ֚עַן עָבְר֣וּ בְרִיתִ֔י פָּשָֽׁעוּ׃ וְעַל־ תּוֹרָתִ֖י
verses.transliteration: šō·p̄ār ’el- ḥik·kə·ḵā kan·ne·šer ‘al- bêṯ Yah·weh ya·‘an ‘ā·ḇə·rū ḇə·rî·ṯî pā·šā·‘ū wə·‘al- tō·w·rā·ṯî
verses.literal: [Put] the ram’s horn to your lips An eagle looms over the house of the LORD because [the people] have transgressed My covenant and rebelled against My law
Israel cries out to Me O our God we know You
[But] Israel has rejected good an enemy will pursue him

verses.original: הֵ֤ם הִמְלִיכוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א מִמֶּ֔נִּי הֵשִׂ֖ירוּ וְלֹ֣א יָדָ֑עְתִּי כַּסְפָּ֣ם וּזְהָבָ֗ם עָשׂ֤וּ לָהֶם֙ עֲצַבִּ֔ים לְמַ֖עַן יִכָּרֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: hêm him·lî·ḵū wə·lō mim·men·nî hê·śî·rū wə·lō yā·ḏā·‘ə·tî kas·pām ū·zə·hā·ḇām ‘ā·śū lā·hem ‘ă·ṣab·bîm lə·ma·‘an yik·kā·rêṯ
verses.literal: They set up kings but not by Me They make princes but without My approval With their silver and gold they make themselves idols to their own destruction

verses.original: זָנַח֙ עֶגְלֵ֣ךְ שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן אַפִּ֖י חָרָ֥ה בָּ֑ם עַד־ מָתַ֕י לֹ֥א יוּכְל֖וּ נִקָּיֹֽן׃
verses.transliteration: zā·naḥ ‘eḡ·lêḵ šō·mə·rō·wn ’ap·pî ḥā·rāh bām ‘aḏ- mā·ṯay lō yū·ḵə·lū niq·qā·yōn
verses.literal: He has rejected your calf O Samaria My anger burns against them How long will they be . . . incapable . . . of innocence

verses.original: כִּ֤י וְה֔וּא מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל֙ חָרָ֣שׁ עָשָׂ֔הוּ ה֑וּא כִּֽי־ וְלֹ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים יִֽהְיֶ֔ה שְׁבָבִ֣ים עֵ֖גֶל שֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: kî wə·hū mî·yiś·rā·’êl ḥā·rāš ‘ā·śā·hū hū kî- wə·lō ’ĕ·lō·hîm yih·yeh šə·ḇā·ḇîm ‘ê·ḡel šō·mə·rō·wn
verses.literal: For this thing is from Israel a craftsman made it and it . . . is not God It will be broken to pieces that calf of Samaria

verses.original: כִּ֛י יִזְרָ֖עוּ ר֥וּחַ יִקְצֹ֑רוּ וְסוּפָ֣תָה אֵֽין־ ל֗וֹ קָמָ֣ה צֶ֚מַח בְּלִ֣י יַֽעֲשֶׂה־ קֶּ֔מַח אוּלַ֣י יַֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה זָרִ֖ים יִבְלָעֻֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî yiz·rā·‘ū rū·aḥ yiq·ṣō·rū wə·sū·p̄ā·ṯāh ’ên- lōw qā·māh ṣe·maḥ bə·lî ya·‘ă·śeh- qe·maḥ ’ū·lay ya·‘ă·śeh zā·rîm yiḇ·lā·‘u·hū
verses.literal: For they sow the wind and they shall reap the whirlwind There is no standing grain what sprouts fails to yield flour Even if it should produce the foreigners would swallow it up

verses.original: יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל נִבְלַ֖ע עַתָּה֙ הָי֣וּ בַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֵֽין־ חֵ֥פֶץ בּֽוֹ׃ כִּכְלִ֖י
verses.transliteration: yiś·rā·’êl niḇ·la‘ ‘at·tāh hā·yū ḇag·gō·w·yim ’ên- ḥê·p̄eṣ bōw kiḵ·lî
verses.literal: Israel is swallowed up Now they are among the nations like a worthless . . . vessel

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הֵ֙מָּה֙ עָל֣וּ אַשּׁ֔וּר פֶּ֖רֶא בּוֹדֵ֣ד ל֑וֹ אֶפְרַ֖יִם הִתְנ֥וּ אֲהָבִֽים
verses.transliteration: kî- hêm·māh ‘ā·lū ’aš·šūr pe·re bō·w·ḏêḏ lōw ’ep̄·ra·yim hiṯ·nū ʾă·hå̄·ḇīm
verses.literal: For they have gone up to Assyria like a wild donkey on its own . . . Ephraim has hired lovers

verses.original: גַּ֛ם כִּֽי־ יִתְנ֥וּ בַגּוֹיִ֖ם עַתָּ֣ה אֲקַבְּצֵ֑ם וַיָּחֵ֣לּוּ מְּעָ֔ט מִמַּשָּׂ֖א מֶ֥לֶךְ שָׂרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: gam kî- yiṯ·nū ḇag·gō·w·yim ‘at·tāh ’ă·qab·bə·ṣêm way·yā·ḥêl·lū mə·‘āṭ mim·maś·śā me·leḵ śā·rîm
verses.literal: Though . . . they hire allies among the nations I will now round them up and they will begin to diminish under the oppression of the king of princes

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אֶפְרַ֛יִם הִרְבָּ֥ה מִזְבְּחֹ֖ת לַחֲטֹ֑א הָיוּ־ ל֥וֹ מִזְבְּח֖וֹת לַחֲטֹֽא׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ep̄·ra·yim hir·bāh miz·bə·ḥōṯ la·ḥă·ṭō hā·yū- lōw miz·bə·ḥō·wṯ la·ḥă·ṭō
verses.literal: Though Ephraim multiplied the altars for sin they became his altars for sinning

verses.original: אֶכְתּוֹב ל֔וֹ רִבּוֹ תּֽוֹרָתִ֑י נֶחְשָֽׁבוּ׃ כְּמוֹ־ זָ֖ר
verses.transliteration: ʾɛḵ·tōḇ lōw rib·bō tō·w·rā·ṯî neḥ·šā·ḇū kə·mōw- zār
verses.literal: Though I wrote for them . . . the great things of My law they regarded them as something strange

verses.original: יִזְבְּח֤וּ זִבְחֵ֣י הַבְהָבַ֗י וַיֹּאכֵ֔לוּ בָשָׂר֙ יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֣א רָצָ֑ם עַתָּ֞ה יִזְכֹּ֤ר עֲוֺנָם֙ וְיִפְקֹ֣ד חַטֹּאותָ֔ם הֵ֖מָּה יָשֽׁוּבוּ׃ מִצְרַ֥יִם
verses.transliteration: yiz·bə·ḥū ziḇ·ḥê haḇ·hā·ḇay way·yō·ḵê·lū ḇā·śār Yah·weh lō rā·ṣām ‘at·tāh yiz·kōr ‘ă·wō·nām wə·yip̄·qōḏ ḥaṭ·ṭō·w·ṯām hêm·māh yā·šū·ḇū miṣ·ra·yim
verses.literal: Though they offer sacrifices as gifts to Me and [though they] eat the meat the LORD does not accept them Now He will remember their iniquity and punish their sins They will return to Egypt

verses.original: יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־ וַיִּשְׁכַּ֨ח עֹשֵׂ֗הוּ וַיִּ֙בֶן֙ הֵֽיכָל֔וֹת וִֽיהוּדָ֕ה הִרְבָּ֖ה בְּצֻר֑וֹת עָרִ֣ים וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי־ אֵ֣שׁ בְּעָרָ֔יו וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- way·yiš·kaḥ ‘ō·śê·hū way·yi·ḇen hê·ḵā·lō·wṯ wî·hū·ḏāh hir·bāh bə·ṣu·rō·wṯ ‘ā·rîm wə·šil·laḥ·tî- ’êš bə·‘ā·rāw wə·’ā·ḵə·lāh ’ar·mə·nō·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: Israel - has forgotten his Maker and built palaces Judah has multiplied its fortified cities But I will send fire upon their cities and it will consume their citadels
